s.note: a whole cheese pizza, all to himself
s.how: Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with a garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes. Stretch 500g pizza dough thin, spread with sauce and cover with 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot tray at the oven's highest heat for 6 minutes and cut into small squares.

s.note: the paint cans swinging down the stairs
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss half with 30g melted butter and salt. Melt 150g white chocolate with red colouring and toss through the other half, then let it set. Mix both together and serve in clean paint tins.

m.note: the TV dinner he heats up all by himself
m.how: Cook 400g macaroni 2 minutes short. Melt 50g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour, whisk in 750ml milk until thick, then add 250g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard. Fold through, top with 50g breadcrumbs and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

w.note: the cookies left out for the house
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll out, cut into stars and trees and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar, some tinted green, and add silver cachous.

d.note: keep the change with this one
d.how: Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp chocolate syrup for 30 seconds until thick. Drizzle a little more chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses, pour in the shake and top with 150ml whipped cream and a cocktail cherry.
